entities.summary: An ancient synagogue uncovered at dura-europos, syria, in 1932. the last phase of construction was dated by an aramaic inscription to 244 ad, making it one of the oldest synagogues in the world Created c. 150. Dura-Europos synagogue is a synagogue, created circa 150 CE. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
